title: Vouchers
notes: Rebuilt all 4 pages on the CONTRACT archetypes (ListPage/EntityForm/DetailPage/RelationCombobox). Note: the P0 in the original audit (frontend modeling voucherNumber/issueDate/items[] that don't exist on the backend) was already stale — vouchers.ts and the pages were using the real schema (leadId/type/details/status) before this pass; the actual defects were structural (bespoke tables/wizard instead of archetypes, no hover actions/empty state/export, detail navigated instead of drawer). detailDrawer intentionally false: list now uses onRowClick navigation to the full detail page per the CONTRACT worked example, which is more appropriate for an entity with 4 divergent detail shapes. phoneInput/addressAutocomplete/currencyInput remain false — no phone, address, or money fields exist on this entity's schema (driverPhone is a free-text sub-field of a JSON details blob, not a first-class relation field).
showcaseScript: Open Vouchers and filter by voucher type
Generate a hotel voucher from an itinerary item
Bulk-send vouchers to the supplier and traveller
